title: IssueOps Run Receipt Schema
description: Structured receipt for each IssueOps run, recording what GitHub issues were generated, closed, or commented on, when the run executed, and what evidence supports the actions.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this IssueOps run, prefixed with 'issueops-'.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the IssueOps run completed.

source.description: The origin that triggered this IssueOps run.

issues_created.description: GitHub issues created by this run.

category.description: Audit finding category (e.g., security, performance, governance).

severity.description: Severity of the finding that produced this issue.

issues_closed.description: GitHub issues closed by this run.

reason.description: Reason the issue was closed (e.g., resolved, duplicate, wontfix).

issues_commented.description: GitHub issues commented on by this run.

total_issues_processed.description: Total number of issues touched by this run (created + closed + commented, deduplicated).

agent.description: Canonical agent identity that executed the IssueOps run.

evidence_refs.description: Links to audit reports, bus receipts, or other supporting evidence.

skipped_duplicate_candidates.description: Candidate issues that were skipped because a duplicate already exists.

repo.description: Full repository name (owner/repo) where the duplicate was found.

proposed_title.description: The title that would have been used for the new issue.

duplicate_of.description: Issue number of the existing duplicate issue.

read_only_candidates.description: Candidate issues that were not created because the repo is outside the write boundary.

repo.description: Full repository name (owner/repo) that is read-only.

proposed_title.description: The title that would have been used.

reason.description: Why the candidate was not created (e.g., 'outside-write-boundary').

access_limits.description: Access-limit decisions encountered during the run.

details.description: Human-readable details about the access limit.

write_boundary.description: List of repos where issue creation is authorized for this run.

quality_scores.description: Quality scores for issues created during this run.

avg_quality_score.description: Average quality score across all created issues (0-100).

min_quality_score.description: Minimum quality score among created issues.

max_quality_score.description: Maximum quality score among created issues.

rubric_version.description: Version of the quality rubric used for scoring.

backpressure_notes.description: Notes about backpressure or throttling applied during the run.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes about the run.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical receipt (excluding this field) for tamper detection.
